name: Guest sign-up prompt timing
hypothesis: Deferring the sign-up prompt until after the first entry is composed increases guest->free conversion.

variants.description: Prompt on tapping the log CTA (current router guard behaviour)
Allow composing the entry, prompt at save

decision_note: Treatment wins decisively but requires local draft persistence, which lands on the same missing outbox as offline_mode. Shipping without it would increase the guest-sync data-loss surface.

name: Premium page: shipped-features-only copy
hypothesis: Advertising only shipped capabilities reduces trust damage without materially reducing upgrade intent.

variants.description: Roadmap framing: coming soon labels per benefit

decision_note: Accepted an intent decrease in exchange for a 75% reduction in trust-damage tickets. Intent is worthless while checkout does not exist.

name: Dark mode contrast tokens
hypothesis: Raising dark-mode token contrast to WCAG AA improves task success without harming perceived design quality.

variants.description: Current deep-purple tokens (2.6:1 on primary figures)

decision_note: No meaningful aesthetic cost. Addresses part of the accessibility procurement gap.

name: Logging reminder (web push) for lapsing users
hypothesis: A single daily reminder at the user's historical logging time recovers lapsing users.

variants.description: Web push at learned time, opt-in

decision_note: Interim read at 17 days. Opt-in rate 34% on iOS web (PWA install required), 71% on Android web — reinforces the native app ask.

name: Range query behind exercise history (7 queries -> 1)
hypothesis: Replacing per-day fan-out with a single range query cuts render time and abandonment.
decision_note: Also removes the throttling exposure behind INC-2026-041 and cuts read cost ~7x. Blocked on schema review because the same review covers the unit-preference field and the plan/report types (ADR-001).

name: Static starter plan card on the exercise dashboard
hypothesis: Showing a hardcoded 3-session starter week will lift repeat-session variety and W2 return even without real generation.
decision_note: Static card lifted W2 return 11.4% and cut verbatim session repeats from 71% to 58%. The card cannot adapt, so 34% of treatment users abandoned the plan by week 3. Validates demand for generation, not the static card.

name: Weekly recap screen built from client-side aggregation
hypothesis: A weekly recap assembled from 7 per-day queries will lift return visits enough to justify the range-query work.

variants.description: Weekly recap assembled from 7 per-day queries

decision_note: Engagement lift was real but p95 render hit 11.2s on the 7-query fan-out and 28% abandoned before render. Stopped on performance, not on demand. Re-run after the range query lands (#557).

name: Unit toggle in profile edit (display-only conversion)
hypothesis: Offering imperial display will reduce profile abandonment and implausible-value entry in US/UK locales.

variants.description: Imperial display toggle (conversion on read only)

decision_note: Largest effect measured this quarter for the smallest change. Implausible-weight warnings fell 81% in treatment. Display-only conversion is insufficient on its own — entry must convert too — but the direction is unambiguous.
